settings.editor: How refund requests are handled for purchases made from Onyx Research. This Policy forms part of our Terms & Conditions.
Last updated: 9 July 2026
This Refund Policy governs all refund requests relating to purchases made from Onyx Research Ltd ("Onyx Research").
It forms part of our Terms & Conditions and should be read alongside them.
Because of the nature of the products we supply, many of which are temperature-sensitive, perishable and supplied in sealed packaging, refunds are strictly limited.
Risk transfers to you as soon as the order is shipped, after which we cannot assess how it has been stored.
cold-chain or temperature-sensitive products once they have been dispatched;
any product whose sealed, tamper-evident packaging has been opened or broken;
products that have been opened, used, tampered with, stored incorrectly or exposed to unsuitable conditions after delivery;
products where a temperature excursion is suspected or confirmed.
Please notify us of any damage or incorrect items within 24 hours of delivery, including photographic evidence.
Reporting after this timeframe may void eligibility.
We may grant a refund at our discretion where required by law or in exceptional circumstances.
Any such refund does not waive our rights under this Policy.
where you request cancellation of an order after payment has been processed, we reserve the right to deduct any non-refundable payment processing fees incurred;

payments made by credit card, debit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or any other card-based method may be subject to a deduction of up to 5% of the transaction value to reflect merchant processing charges, banking fees and administrative costs;
no refund or cancellation is available once an order has been fulfilled, prepared for dispatch, allocated for shipment, packed, labelled or otherwise entered the fulfilment process;
once an order has been dispatched, sections 2 and 3 of this Policy apply in full;
any refund we approve is made only to the original payment method used for the purchase.
Requests should be submitted through our contact form or by email at sales@onyxhealth.net.
Please include your order reference, a description of the issue and supporting evidence.
This Policy is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
